How many of the stocks ICES gives advice on have their assessment in TAF, linked to the advice.

A stock counts as implemented in TAF for a year when it has a repository in [ices-advice](https://github.com/ices-advice) for that year, and the matching `_assessment` repository in [ices-taf](https://github.com/ices-taf) contains a `model.R` script. The number of stocks, their expert group and data category come from the [ICES Stock Database](https://sd.ices.dk).
